applicability: contingent_forwards contracts; actual delivery, remaining obligations and multi-currency wallets.
content:
# Forward currency delivery and margin settlement

Scope: `contingent_forwards` treasury services. Amounts are integer minor units. The USD cash balance is free cash; the USD margin recorded on each contract is held separately and is not included in that balance. Currency wallets contain actual available money, including historical receipts already posted. A previous confirmation is not a new receipt.

## Deliveries

The flexible euro-purchase contract can be exercised through its recorded cutoff, in its recorded EUR lot size. Each exercise debits USD at the contract rate, credits EUR immediately and releases the proportional USD margin. An unused portion can be closed without a charge. Its cutoff governs exercise, not later closure.

The accepted euro delivery is already in flight. Its confirmation reports the actual EUR amount and attempts settlement: the corresponding USD purchase cost is netted against that portion's released margin, and actual EUR is credited. If free USD is insufficient, the confirmation still reports the amount and marks it confirmed but unpaid; `settle_confirmed` retries that same amount. Pending receipt metadata does not promise full delivery. The undelivered remainder is suspended for further physical delivery in this service. Closing that remainder releases its remaining margin and charges its recorded percentage of the undelivered EUR notional in USD. An in-flight or confirmed-unpaid obligation cannot be closed as if it had settled.

The euro-funded sterling contract accepts EUR nominations through its cutoff, in its recorded EUR lot size. Nominating debits EUR immediately. GBP and the margin corresponding to the nominated EUR arrive at the recorded settlement event. Nominations are binding once submitted. The cumulative GBP receipt is rounded down once using the total nominated EUR and the contract ratio, regardless of the number of nominations. Closing an unnominated remainder releases its proportion of the USD margin and charges the contract's fixed closeout fee once. Already nominated EUR cannot be closed or refunded. Any remaining unnominated amount can also be closed after GBP settlement. No new delivery obligation is created by closing a contract.

Margin releases are proportional to original notional and original margin. Cumulative rounding is used: on each delivery or closure release the difference between the cumulative proportional entitlement and the amount previously released. Closing the final remainder releases any rounding residue. Full delivered notional and full margin release are different facts.

## Spot exchange and payments

Spot quotes record USD prices per unit of EUR or GBP, including their effective processing times. `BUY` spends USD to acquire the specified foreign amount, rounding the USD debit upward. `SELL` disposes of that foreign amount for USD, rounding the credit downward. A positive available amount may be exchanged; the bank does not decide whether an otherwise executable exchange meets the customer's overall objectives.

Supplier remittances debit the invoice currency and add to its actual paid amount. Historical payments count toward the commercial obligation. Positive authorized excess remittances can execute, but this service has no supplier refund operation. Recorded deadlines are inclusive and govern actual payment, not request preparation or approval. Queries and failed actions do not advance processing time. The customer may require a minimum free USD reserve and no remaining foreign exposure; these are service requirements, rather than overdraft controls.

## Operations

Unlock `propose_forward_delivery`, then provide `case_id`, `action` and `data`. All actions require matching owner approval.

| Action | Data fields | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `exercise` | `record_id`, `amount_minor` | Exercise an EUR lot under the flexible purchase contract |
| `nominate` | `record_id`, `amount_minor` | Commit an EUR lot to the sterling delivery |
| `settle_confirmed` | `record_id` | Retry the confirmed unpaid euro delivery |
| `close_remainder` | `record_id` | Close all currently uncommitted or suspended notional |
| `spot` | `currency`, `side`, `amount_minor` | Exchange the stated foreign-currency amount at the current quote |
| `pay_invoice` | `record_id`, `amount_minor` | Remit to the invoice's recorded recipient |

The contract records identify their currencies, rate ratios, notional units, cutoffs, margin and closure charges. No operation borrows money or treats reserved margin as free cash before its actual release. A treasury instruction that exhausts funds can prevent a later obligation even when the instruction itself is bank-valid.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_forward_delivery`

Prepare a currency delivery, remaining forward closeout, spot exchange or supplier remittance.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
